title: job.restart_with_changes
description: Make a settings change now, while jobs run, by restarting the work around it. The change (values to set, resets to clear) is checked first, as config.set would. mode resume: the running job pauses at its next safe point, the change is written, and it resumes; the file in progress keeps its checkpoints where its keys did not move. mode requeue: every job is cancelled, the change is written, and each job's remaining files are queued again with its own overrides. Answers at once with the jobs it touched; config.applied says when the change is in. With no job, the change is written at once.
